note: LOANS, the owner's way (10 Sep): exactly the Salary Advance flow — amount requested and sanctioned, Manager → Director → HR Admin decisions (signers by designation words), tenure → EMI derived (sanctioned ÷ tenure, rounded up to the rupee), EMI start month, disbursed, recovered per month on the payslip as line LOAN-<id>. Tenures are longer than an advance's. Same rules file shape as config/salary-advance.json.
deciding_note: Owner, 22 Sep: only the HR Admin / HR Manager decision decides the status (Approved → approved, Rejected → rejected, On Hold → on hold, none yet → pending). Manager and Director may record a decision, which is shown, but it neither blocks nor approves. Remove deciding_level to go back to all levels having to approve.
